name: Chromatic aberration — effect fixture
description: Proving fixture for the chromatic-aberration Effect (was dead-by-use — referenced by zero presets). A frame-wide RGB channel-split fringe over high-contrast paper body text; the radial offset grows toward the frame corners (lens-style). Verifies the post-process effect chain renders the aberration while preserving the centre-sample alpha (E4 transparent contract). Fixture — exercises the pipeline, not held to the deliverable floors.

content.body: High-contrast edges make the channel split legible — the coloured fringe grows with distance from the optical centre, the way a real lens disperses light toward the frame corners.
